blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generating interactive 3D assets from a single image requires realistic appearance, fidelity to the depicted object, and plausible physical behavior. Yet detailed geometry alone does not determine how an object should move or deform. We introduce PhysAg3D, which couples 3D generative models with agentic reasoning and tool use. A vision-language agent first infers semantic parts, candidate interactions, and physical priors from the image; a 3D generator then produces a textured whole-object mesh from the same image. A hierarchical interaction representation links these revisable priors to mechanisms and the generated surfaces they control, organizing interaction construction and refinement. Guided by this representation and observations of the mesh, the agent uses geometric and physical tools to construct parts, joints, deformable regions, and surface bindings while retaining useful generated geometry and materials. Rendered interactions and execution measurements guide targeted revisions within a fixed budget. The framework accommodates both rigid articulation and compliant deformation. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on real photographs and external benchmarks demonstrate detailed, image-aligned assets with plausible interactions. Ablations support bounded refinement and source-surface preservation. Project Page: supra-3d.github.io/PhysAg3D.
blocks.zh: 从单一图像中生成交互式的3D资产需要现实的外观,对被描绘对象的忠诚,以及可信的物理行为. 然而,仅是详细的几何并不能确定物体应如何移动或变形。 我们介绍PhysAg3D, 夫妇3D基因模型 具有代理推理和使用工具。 一个视觉语言剂首先从图像中推断出语义部分,候选相互作用,以及物理前缀;一个3D生成器然后从同一张图像中生成一个有文字的全对象网. 分级的相互作用表现将这些可追溯的前科与机制及其控制的所生成的表面联系起来,组织相互作用的构建和完善. 以这种对网状物的表示和观测为取向,物剂使用几何和物理工具来构筑零件,关节,可变形区和地表绑定物,同时保留有用的生成的几何和材料. 互动和执行计量指导在固定预算中进行有针对性的修订。 该框架既包括僵硬的表述,也包括符合要求的变形。 对真实照片和外部基准进行定量和定性评价,显示出详细、与图像相匹配、有合理互动作用的资产。 差额支持有限度地改进和源地表保护。 项目页: 上-3d.github.io/PhysAg3D。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generating interactive 3D assets from a single image offers a scalable way to populate virtual environments and embodied simulations with objects from the real world ( Mildenhall et al., 2020 ; Kerbl et al., 2023 ; Mo et al., 2019 ; Xia et al., 2020 ; Xiang et al., 2020 ) . A useful asset should capture the depicted instance, retain realistic geometric and material detail, and respond to actions in ways appropriate to the object. These goals concern different aspects of quality: a visually convincing reconstruction can remain static, while a functional mechanism can belong to an asset that no longer resembles its reference. The task therefore requires bringing appearance, instance alignment, and physical interaction into a coherent realization.
blocks.zh: 从单一图像中生成交互式3D资产提供了一个可扩展的虚拟环境,并体现了与来自现实世界的物体的模拟(Mildenhall等人,2020年;Kerbl等人,2023年;Mo等人,2019年;Xia等人,2020年;Xiang等人,2020年)。 有用的资产应抓住所描绘的例子,保留现实的几何和物质细节,并以适合目标的方式对行动作出反应。 这些目标涉及质量的不同方面:视觉上令人信服的重建可以保持不变,而功能机制可以属于不再类似于其参照的资产。 因此,这项任务需要使外观、实例协调和物理互动成为一致的实现。

blocks.en: Recent advances provide strong foundations for this task. Image-conditioned generators synthesize detailed geometry and materials ( Poole et al., 2023 ; Jun and Nichol, 2023 ; Nichol et al., 2022 ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Qian et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023a ; Shi et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023b ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Long et al., 2024 ; Tochil and others, 2024 ; Xu and others, 2024 ; Du et al., 2024a ; Voleti et al., 2024 ; Tang and others, 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025b ; Xiang et al., 2025a ) ; articulated and physical generation methods infer part structure, motion, and material behavior ( Mo et al., 2019 ; Xia et al., 2020 ; Yu et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Xiang et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ; Makoviychuk et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2020 ) ; and agentic systems construct and revise assets through executable programs, visual grounding, and feedback ( Ahn et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023a ; Huang et al., 2023b ; Huang et al., 2023a ; Driess et al., 2023 ; Brohan et al., 2023 ; Singh et al., 2023 ; Valmeekam et al., 2023 ; Le et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . A remaining challenge is to maintain agreement between what an object is expected to do, how that behavior is implemented, and which visible surfaces actually respond. A single image underdetermines hidden mechanisms and physical parameters, and a generated mesh need not expose the semantic parts required for interaction. Furthermore, a valid joint or deformable simulation does not ensure that the corresponding detailed surface moves with it. Addressing these discrepancies can require changes to geometry and physical structure, creating a further tension between functional construction and preservation of the depicted appearance.
blocks.zh: 最近的进展为这项任务奠定了坚实的基础。 成像型发电机合成了详细的几何学和材料(Poole等人,2023年;Jun和Nichol等人,2023年;Nichol等人,2022年;Lin等人,2023年;Qian等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年a年;Shi等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年b年;Hong等人,2024年;Long等人,2024年;Tochil等人,2024年), 2024年; 徐等人, 2024年; 杜等人, 2024年a; 伏列提等人, 2024年; 唐等人, ; Xiang et al.,2025b; Xiang et al.,2025a; 清晰和物理生成方法推断部分结构、运动和物质行为(Mo et al.,2019;Xia et al.,2020;Yu et al.,2023;Wang et al.,2019;Xiang et al.,2020;Liu et al.,2025;Liu et al.,2026;Cao et al.,2026;Makoviychuk et al.,2021;Hu et al.,2020);通过可执行程序、可视地定位和反馈构建和修订资产的代理系统(Ahn et al.,2022;Li等人,2023a; Huang等人,2023b;Huang等人,2023a;Driess等人,2023;Brohan等人,2023;Singh等人,2023;Valmeekam等人,2023;Le等人,2025;Zhou等人,2026;Wang等人,2026). 剩下的一个挑战,是保持一个物体的预期作用,该行为是如何执行的,以及哪些可见的表面实际反应的一致. 一个单一的图像下定义隐藏机制和物理参数,生成的网格不需要暴露相互作用所需的语义部分. 此外,有效的联合或变形模拟不能确保相应的详细表面随其移动。 解决这些差异可能需要改变几何和物理结构,在功能构造和所描绘的外观保存之间造成进一步的紧张.

blocks.en: We introduce PhysAg3D , a framework for single-image interactive asset generation through generative–agentic coupling . Our central idea is to combine the instance-specific geometry and appearance supplied by a pretrained 3D generator with an agent’s ability to reason about object behavior and construct executable physical models. The generated asset provides a detailed visual foundation; agentic reasoning turns this foundation into an interactive realization and revises it in response to observed behavior. This division of capabilities allows physical construction to make use of rich generated surfaces while remaining responsive to the structure and interactions of the depicted object. Figure 1 illustrates this goal through mixer-head articulation, compass-lid closure, telescope reorientation, and local ear-pad deformation. The examples associate actions with specific moving or deforming regions while retaining recognizable object structure and surface detail.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PhysAg3D, 即通过基因-代理结合生成单一图像交互资产的框架。 我们的中心思想是结合由预先训练的3D生成器提供的特异性几何和外观,以及代理人对物体行为进行推理和构建可执行物理模型的能力. 生成的资产提供了详细的视觉基础;代理推理将这个基础转化为交互实现,并针对观察到的行为对其进行修改. 这种能力划分使得物理构造能够利用丰富的生成的表面,同时保持对被描绘物体的结构和相互作用的反应. 图1通过搅拌机头伸缩、罗盘盖闭合、望远镜定向以及局部耳板变形来说明这一目标。 这些例子将动作与特定的移动或变形区域联系起来,同时保留可识别的物体结构和表面细节。

blocks.en: Specifically, a vision-language agent first infers revisable semantic and physical priors from the image, and a 3D generator produces a textured whole-object mesh from the same image. We propose a hierarchical interaction representation for this coupling, connecting semantic requirements, physical mechanisms, and concrete asset realizations. Explicit correspondences associate intended interactions with the structures and visible surfaces that implement them. Guided by these relationships and observations of the mesh, the agent uses geometric and physical tools to construct parts, joints or compliant regions, and surface bindings while retaining useful generated geometry and materials. Rendered interactions and execution measurements then guide targeted revisions with bounded construction and validation attempts. The representation expresses both rigid articulation and compliant deformation through their respective relationships between physical state and visible appearance. Our contributions are threefold: • A generative–agentic framework that grounds interaction construction in image-derived priors while retaining useful surfaces and materials from detailed whole-object generation. • A hierarchical interaction representation that connects requirements, mechanisms, and concrete surface realizations to organize construction and feedback-guided refinement. • Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on real photographs and external benchmarks, assessing appearance, image alignment, and interaction attributes, with ablations of bounded refinement and source-surface preservation.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,一个视觉语言剂首先推断出图像中可重视的语义和物理前缀,一个3D生成器从同一个图像中产生一个纹理化的全对象网格. 我们为这种组合提出了分层互动代表,将语义要求、物理机制和具体资产实现联系起来。 明确通信将预期的互动与执行这些互动的结构和可见表面联系起来。 在网状物的这些关系和观测的指导下,物剂使用几何和物理工具来构建零件,关节或符合区域,以及表面绑定,同时保留有用的生成的几何和材料. 然后,通过有限度的施工和验证努力,指导有针对性的修订工作。 这种表述通过物理状态和可见的外观之间的各自关系,表达僵硬的表述和符合的变形. 我们的贡献有三个方面: · 一个基因 - 物剂框架,在图像产生的前缀中说明相互作用的结构,同时保留详细的全物体生成的有用表面和材料。 • 支助 分级互动代表,将要求,机制和混凝土表面实现联系起来,组织施工和反馈引导完善. • 对真实照片和外部基准进行定量和定性评价,评估外观、图像对齐和互动属性,同时进行有限度的改进和源表面保护。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early text-to-3D systems distilled diffusion priors into 3D representations ( Poole et al., 2023 ; Jun and Nichol, 2023 ; Nichol et al., 2022 ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Qian et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2026 ) ; feed-forward and multi-view methods improved single-image consistency and speed ( Liu et al., 2023a ; Shi et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023b ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Long et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024b ; Tochil and others, 2024 ; Xu and others, 2024 ; Voleti et al., 2024 ; Tang and others, 2024 ) . TRELLIS introduces structured 3D latents, and TRELLIS.2 supports detailed geometry and physically based materials ( Xiang et al., 2025b ; Xiang et al., 2025a ) . UniLat3D unifies geometry and appearance in a shared latent space for single-stage image-to-3D generation ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . SINGAPO conditions articulated parts on images and part relationships ( Liu et al., 2025 ) ; PAct jointly generates geometry, composition, and articulation ( Liu et al., 2026 ) ; PhysX-Omni covers rigid, deformable, and articulated objects ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . Shape, surface, and texture reconstruction further improve appearance ( Gao et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023b ; Huang et al., 2023c ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Chen and others, 2024 ; Guo et al., 2020 ; Müller et al., 2022 ; Laine et al., 2020 ) . More recently, SUPRA-TEX generates relightable materials faithful to reference images by anchoring visible-surface observations in material latent space while completing unobserved regions ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . PhysAg3D studies agent-driven construction and revision around a detailed whole-object reconstruction, linking image-derived requirements to mechanisms and visible surfaces.
blocks.zh: 早期的文本到-3D系统将扩散前缀蒸馏成3D表达式(Poole等人,2023年;Jun和Nichol等人,2023年;Nichol等人,2022年;Lin等人,2023年;Qian等人,2023年;Tang等人,2023年;Du等人,2026年);饲料法和多视图法提高了单图像的一致性和速度(Liu等人,2023年a年; Shi等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年b;Hong等人,2024年;Long等人,2024年;Du等人,2024年b;Tochil等人, 2024年;徐等,2024年;伏列提等,2024年;唐等,2024年). TRELLIS引入了结构化的3D潜伏物,TRELLIS.2支持详细的几何和物理材料(Xiang等人,2025年b; Xiang等人,2025a). UniLat3D统一几何和在单相图像到3D生成的共享潜在空间中出现(Wu等人,2026年). SINGAPO的条件阐明了图像和部分关系的部分内容(Liu等人,2025年); PAct联合生成几何,组成,以及表达(刘等人,2026年);PhysX-Omni覆盖刚性,可变形,以及表达对象(曹等人,2026年). 形状、表面和纹理重建进一步改善外观(Gao等人,2022年;Li等人,2023年b); 黄等人,2023c;曹等人,. 2023年;陈 and等人, 2024; Guo等人, 2020; Müller等人, 2022; Laine等人, 2020 ). 最近,SUPRA-TEX通过在物质潜伏空间锚定可见表面观测,同时完成未观测区域,生成忠实于参考图像的可燃材料(Yang等人,2026年)。 PhysAg3D围绕一个详细的全对象重建来研究由物剂驱动的构造和修正,将图像衍生的要求与机制和可见表面联系起来.

blocks.en: PartNet, PartNet-Mobility, GAPartNet, and Shape2Motion support research on parts, affordances, and mobility ( Mo et al., 2019 ; Xia et al., 2020 ; Yu et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2019 ) . Articulate AnyMesh segments movable parts and refines joints for open-vocabulary meshes ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) . Particulate predicts segmentation, kinematics, and motion constraints in one pass ( Li et al., 2025 ) ; Instruct-Particulate adds semantic and point-prompt conditioning, combining 3D generation with vision-language inference for image-to-asset articulation ( Li et al., 2026b ) . PhysAg3D focuses on connecting intended interactions, physical entities, exported bindings, and observed surface responses, including compliant regions whose simulation and visible geometry differ.
blocks.zh: PartNet,PartNet-Mobility,GAPartNet,和Shape2Motion支持关于零件,付得起,流动性的研究(Mo等人,2019年;Xia等人,2020年;Yu等人,2023年;Wang等人,2019年). 说明 Anymesh的可移动部件,并精炼开口-vocabulary meshes的关节(Quu等人,2025年)。 分解在一次通过中预测分解,动能,运动约束(Li等人,2025年) ; 指令-分解增加语义和点瞬态,结合3D生成和视觉语言推论进行图像对资产表达(Li等人,2026年b) . PhysAg3D侧重于连接预期的相互作用,物理实体,导出绑定物,以及观测到的表面反应,包括模拟和可见几何特征不同的符合区域.

blocks.en: Articulate-Anything uses vision-language reasoning and actor–critic refinement for articulated modeling ( Le et al., 2025 ) . Language-guided robotics connects instructions to executable actions and closed-loop spatial reasoning ( Ahn et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023a ; Huang et al., 2023b ; Huang et al., 2023a ; Driess et al., 2023 ; Brohan et al., 2023 ) , while planning studies emphasize replanning and verification ( Singh et al., 2023 ; Valmeekam et al., 2023 ) . ArtiCraft provides a part-and-joint SDK, object-specific tests, and structured execution feedback ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . aDSL unifies hierarchical modeling and spatial relations for planning, execution, and critique, combining procedural scaffolds with TRELLIS through SpaceControl ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Shape programs and CAD languages offer related compositional abstractions and persistent references ( Jones et al., 2020 ; Jones et al., 2025 ; Cascaval et al., 2023 ) . PhysAg3D links requirements, mechanisms, and concrete realizations to generated surfaces. Visual and execution evidence guides local revision while preserving useful geometry.
blocks.zh: 任何事物都使用视觉语言的推理和演员——批评性地完善了清晰的模型(Le等人,2025年)。 语言引导机器人将指令连接到可执行动作和闭路空间推理(Ahn等人,2022年;Li等人,2023年a; Huang et al., 2023b; Huang et al., 2023a; Driess et al., 2023; Brohan et al., 2023 ),而规划研究强调重新规划和核查(Singh et al., 2023;Valmeekam et al., 2023 ). ArtiCraft提供部分和联合的SDK,对象特异性测试,以及结构化的执行反馈(周等人,2026年). aDSL统一了规划、执行和批评的等级模型和空间关系,通过空间控制将程序脚手架与TRELLIS相结合(Wang等人,2026年)。 形状程序和CAD语言提供了相关的组成抽象和持续引用(Jones等人,2020年;Jones等人,2025年;Cascaval等人,2023年)。 PhysAg3D将要求,机制和具体实现与生成的表面联系起来. 视觉和执行证据指导局部修改,同时保留有用的几何.

blocks.en: MuJoCo, PyBullet, Isaac Gym, and differentiable simulators provide complementary dynamics and contact substrates ( Todorov et al., 2012 ; Coumans and Bai, 2016 ; Makoviychuk et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2020 ) . Segment Anything, DINOv2, and CLIP provide visual grouping and image–text alignment primitives ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Radford et al., 2021 ) . These form contextual foundations for PhysAg3D’s explicit interaction-to-surface representation.
blocks.zh: MujoCo, PyBullet, Isaaac Gym, 以及不同的模拟器提供了互补动力学和接触底物(Todorov等人,2012年;Coumans和Bai,2016年;Makoviychuk等人,2021年;Hu等人,2020年). 任何部分,DINov2和CLIP提供视觉分组和图像对齐原始文本(Kirillov等人,2023年;Oquab等人,2024年;Radford等人,2021年)。 这些构成了PhysAg3D明确的互动和表面表现的背景基础。

blocks.en: 3  Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1  Task Definition and Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务定义和框架概述

blocks.en: Given a single image I I , PhysAg3D generates a textured 3D asset with object-specific interactions. An asset contains visible geometry and materials, physical entities and parameters, controls, and bindings from physical state to visible surfaces. We evaluate appearance, image alignment, and physical behavior separately; construction targets the declared interactions, since hidden structure, scale, and material parameters are not determined by one image.
blocks.zh: 考虑到一个I的单一图像,PhysAg3D生成一个有纹理的3D资产,有特定对象的相互作用. 一项资产包含可见几何和材料、物理实体和参数、控制以及从物理状态到可见表面的束缚。 我们分别评价外观,图像对齐,和物理行为;构造目标为宣布的相互作用,因为隐藏的结构,尺度,和物质参数不是由一个图像决定的.

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the workflow. Image interpretation produces revisable semantic and physical hypotheses, while a pretrained generator provides a detailed whole-object mesh. Mechanism reasoning connects these sources through interaction intent S S (what should happen), physical structure K K (which mechanism produces it), and concrete realization X X (the implementing asset entities and bindings). Asset construction realizes these mechanisms and bindings; evidence attribution links observations to the responsible regions for local revision. These are functional roles in one agentic loop. Appendix A details the interaction representation, construction procedures, validation checks, and candidate-selection policy.
blocks.zh: 图2概述了工作流程。 图像解析产生可重视的语义和物理假说,而预先训练的生成器则提供详细的全对象网. 机制推理通过互动意图S S(应发生什么),实体结构K K(产生它的机制),以及具体实现X X(执行资产实体和约束),将这些来源联系起来。 资产建设实现这些机制和约束;证据归属将观察与责任地区联系起来,进行地方修改. 这些都是在一个代理循环中的功能作用. 附 录 详细介绍互动代表、施工程序、验证检查和候选人甄选政策。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of PhysAg3D with an excavator example. (1) Image-derived priors are combined with a generated textured mesh. (2) Interaction intent S S specifies lifting, reaching, and curling; physical structure K K specifies the corresponding joints; concrete realization X X implements them with asset entities and bindings, illustrated here by its visible surfaces. (3) Asset construction binds surfaces to physical entities, and evidence attribution links observations back to the representation for local revision. Mechanism reasoning, asset construction, and evidence attribution operate within one agentic loop. Close-ups show body–boom, boom–stick, and stick–bucket connections; reference and posed states illustrate articulation.

blocks.en: Our benchmark contains more than 200 real-object photographs; evaluation uses a fixed subset of 50 objects with 110 predefined semantic actions, spanning rigid, compliant, and mixed objects. Development cases are identified separately, and method-specific preprocessing is documented. We compare PhysAg3D with Particulate, PhysX-Omni, PAct, ArtiCraft, and aDSL ( Li et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Additional qualitative comparisons appear in Appendix C .

blocks.en: For input-view consistency, a fixed spatial grid search selects the rendered camera view closest to the input; foreground IoU, PSNR, and CLIP similarity are computed on the aligned pair. Action Completion Rate (ACR) measures correct semantic completion. Strict Mis-Motion Rate (MMR) counts missing, incomplete, incorrectly related, structurally broken, or spuriously coupled actions. Video-based Range Achievement Rate (RAR) scores the maximum valid visible range in { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } \{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1\} after the ACR semantic gate. These three metrics are macro-averaged over objects. Function-and-Visible-Stability Pass (FVSP) is the fraction of objects completing all expected actions without video-visible instability. It assesses rendered video evidence, not simulator-log stability.
blocks.zh: 对于输入-视图一致性,固定的空间网格搜索选择最接近输入的渲染相机视图;前景IoU,PSNR,以及CLIP相似性在对齐对齐上计算. 动作完成率(ACR)测量正确语义完成率. 严格的误动率(MMR)计算出缺失,不完整,关系不正确,结构断裂,或虚假的组合动作. 基于视频的射程实现率(RAR)在ACR语义门后,以{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1}==0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1}评分最高有效可见范围. 这三种度量衡是物体的宏观平均值. 函数与视觉-稳定通道(FVSP)是完成所有预期动作而无视频可见不稳定的物体的一小部分. 它评估提供了视频证据,而不是模拟-日志稳定性。

blocks.en: PhysXVerse and PhysX-Mobility provide reference assets for appearance, geometry, and attribute evaluation, with the dataset split reported by PhysX-Omni ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . blocks.en: PhysX-Bench evaluates generated assets using image and behavior evidence ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . We use its released evidence-generation and scoring pipeline with fixed judge configuration and prompts. In Table 3 , PhysAg3D ties MonoArt on CLIP, ranks second on RQS and MCS, and leads DQS, APS, KPS, MPS, and DCS. These results show strong attribute scores alongside competitive visual quality. The articulation score uses joint playback and does not establish dynamic contact stability.

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares five selected inputs with PAct, Particulate, ArtiCraft, and aDSL ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . PhysAg3D preserves patterned headphones during earcup rotation, camera housing during lens extension, and ornate cart surfaces during wheel rotation; the microscope and butterfly show localized mechanism and wing motion. ArtiCraft and aDSL simplify fine geometry or patterns, while some PAct and Particulate outputs show fragmented surfaces, misplaced parts, or implausible motion.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented PhysAg3D for generating interactive 3D assets from a single image. Its hierarchical representation connects interaction requirements, physical mechanisms, and visible surfaces to guide construction and feedback-based refinement. Experiments support appearance preservation and plausible interactions, with ablations indicating benefits from refinement and surface preservation. Recovering hidden structure and material properties remains a limitation.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了PhysAg3D,用于从单一图像生成交互式3D资产. 其分级代表将互动要求,物理机制,可见表面联系起来,以指导构建和反馈的完善. 实验支持外观的保存和可能的互动,并表明改进和表面保存的好处。 恢复隐藏结构和物质属性仍然是一个限制。

blocks.en: A.1  Interaction Representation
blocks.zh: A.1 互动代表性

blocks.en: The representation in Section 3.2 separates interaction intent, mechanism design, and concrete assets. The semantic level S S identifies the target region, action, expected response, and observation frame. The mechanism level K K specifies bodies or compliant domains, connections, degrees of freedom, supports, and parameter assumptions. The realization level X X identifies the meshes, materials, scene entities, controls, and exported bindings. The relations Γ \Gamma connect these levels; ρ \rho records the origin and modification of source surfaces; and E E associates observations with the candidate that produced them. These correspondences link interaction requirements to mechanisms, realized entities, and surface bindings for construction and feedback-guided revision, as defined in Section 3.2 . The following subsections detail the associated construction and validation procedures.
blocks.zh: 第3.2节中的表述将互动意图、机制设计和具体资产分开。 语义S级确定目标区域,动作,预期反应,以及观测框架. 机制级别 K K 指定机构或符合域,连接,自由度,支持,和参数假设. 实现级别X X 识别 meshes, 材质, 场景实体, 控制和导出绑定值 。 关系 =\Gamma 连接这些关卡; ^\rho 记录源表的起源和修改; E E 将观察与产生它们的候选人联系起来. 这些函证将互动要求与第3.2节界定的机制、已实现的实体以及用于构建和反馈制式修改的表面约束联系起来。 以下各分节详细介绍了相关的施工和验证程序.

blocks.en: For example, a lid-opening requirement refers to the lid region and measures its motion relative to the base. Its mechanism identifies the hinge axis and permitted range, while its realization identifies the moving body and the visible lid faces assigned to it. This correspondence allows the hinge configuration and visible-surface assignment to be inspected separately; it localizes the relevant entities without by itself establishing the cause of a failure. For a padded region, the corresponding records identify the load, support, physical discretization, and visible skin. These examples explain the representation without assuming that hidden mechanisms or material parameters are uniquely recoverable from the input image.
blocks.zh: 例如,盖开要求是指盖开区域,并衡量其相对于基部的运动. 其机制确定轴和允许范围,而其实现则确定移动体和分配给它的可见盖面. 这种通信允许对链条配置和可见表面任务进行单独检查;它将有关实体定位,而无需自行确定故障原因。 对于加法区,相应的记录会识别负载,支持,物理盘状,以及可见的皮肤. 这些例子解释了这种表示,而没有假设隐藏的机制或物质参数可以从输入图像中独有的可回收.

blocks.en: A.2  Geometry, Materials, and Surface Binding
blocks.zh: A.2 几何、材料和表面约束

blocks.en: The initial TRELLIS.2 reconstruction supplies the detailed visible geometry and materials. Geometric refinement uses rendered views and measurements to identify actionable regions: mesh connectivity alone does not determine which parts should move, and a texture boundary need not be a mechanical boundary. Bounded edits preserve useful source faces, UV coordinates, and material assignments. When topology changes, source correspondence must be updated rather than inherited from obsolete face indices.
blocks.zh: 最初的TRELLIS.2重建提供了详细的可见几何和材料. 几何精细化的利用使观点和测量能够确定可操作区域:仅网格连接不能确定哪些部分应该移动,纹理边界不必是机械边界。 捆绑的编辑保存有用的源面,紫外线坐标和材料任务. 当地形变化时,源通信必须更新,而不是从过时的面值指数中继承.

blocks.en: For rigid articulation, visible vertices follow the transform of their assigned body. Correct body ownership, local transforms, parent–child relationships, joint frames, and limits are all needed to produce the intended visible motion. Collision geometry can differ from the detailed render mesh, but motion of a collision proxy alone does not verify motion of the visible part.
blocks.zh: 对于刚性表达,可见的顶点会跟随其分配体的转变. 正确的身体所有权、局部转变、父母-子女关系、联合框架和限制,都是产生预期可见运动所需的。 碰撞几何可以与详细的渲染网格不同,但仅一个碰撞代理的运动并不能验证可见部分的运动.

blocks.en: For compliant regions, the physical discretization and visible skin may also differ. The displacement binding in Eq. 4 transfers physical-node displacements to visible vertices in a common frame. Its node identities, dimensions, weights, and rest geometry are checked against the exported asset. Supports and loading conditions are specified separately from the skin binding. A local deformation observation removes common rigid motion before assessing shape change; otherwise, movement of the entire object could be mistaken for local compliance. The ear-pad example uses an approximate compliance model rather than a material calibration recovered from the image.
blocks.zh: 对于合规区域,物理盘状和可见皮肤也可能有所不同。 Eq. 4中的迁移将物理节点迁移转移到一个共同框架的可见顶点。 其节点身份、尺寸、重量和休息几何特征与出口资产核对。 支撑和装载条件与皮肤绑定分开规定. 局部变形观察在评估形状变化之前会去除常见的刚性运动;否则整个物体的移动会被误认为是局部遵守. 耳板的例子采用近似遵守模式,而不是从图像中恢复的材料校准。

blocks.en: A.3  Feedback and Candidate Records
blocks.zh: A.3 反馈和候选人记录

blocks.en: Rendered observations assess appearance, part separation, and visible response. Execution observations assess the requested action, achieved range, contacts, supports, and applicable deformation or recovery. Each record identifies the requirement, candidate, target region and entities, action, initial state, runtime and assessment configurations, and assessment outcome. The four outcomes are unassessed, pass, fail, and inconclusive. An execution error supplies no measured trajectory, and a changed build requires renewed dynamic evidence.
blocks.zh: 渲染的观察评估外观,部分分离,以及可见的反应. 执行观察评估所要求的行动、达到的范围、联系、支持和适用的变形或恢复。 每一份记录都列明要求、候选人、目标区域和实体、行动、初始状态、运行时间和评估配置以及评估结果。 这四项结果都是未经评估、通过、失败和没有结果的。 执行错误不能提供测量的轨迹,改变的构造需要更新动态证据.

blocks.en: Feedback associates a discrepancy with the relevant mechanism, realized entity, or binding. Local repairs can address motion range, tracking, surface assignment, or assembly; structural replanning addresses topology, ownership, joint-axis, or material contradictions. Previous candidates remain available when a revision fails. The budgets and selection procedure below bound this loop.
blocks.zh: 反馈将差异与相关机制、已实现的实体或约束联系起来。 局部修复可以解决运动范围,跟踪,表面分配,或组装问题;结构重新规划可以解决地形,所有权,联合轴,或物质矛盾. 在修订失败时,仍可找到以前的候选人。 下方的预算和甄选程序约束着这一循环。

blocks.en: A.6  Output Selection
blocks.zh: A.6 产出选择

blocks.en: Selection excludes unloadable, empty, nonfinite, externally dependent assets and detected source-identity conflicts. In autonomous runs, eligible candidates are ranked by appearance evidence, native retention, semantic evidence, absence of unsupported additions, display checks, declared bodies, supported physics acceptance, and recency, in that order. Native retention includes source identity, face accounting, geometry, and UV/material checks. As specified in Section 4.5 , Full pipeline and w/o surface preservation use the same selection rule. In the latter, source-geometry, UV, and material preservation constraints are removed from construction, while the shared ranking criteria and physical-to-visible bindings remain. This intervention therefore tests the construction constraints under a fixed output-selection policy. Supported physics acceptance requires a passing report, at least three trajectory states, and matching asset and trajectory identities. A preview can be returned without a valid dynamic trajectory, with that status kept distinct. If no refined candidate is eligible, the native reconstruction can serve as a static fallback. Such a fallback is not evidence that the requested interaction or dynamic validation succeeded; failed and inconclusive attempts remain in the outcome accounting.

blocks.en: ACR measures correct semantic action completion. Strict MMR counts missing, incomplete, incorrectly related, structurally broken, or spuriously coupled actions. RAR scores the maximum valid visible range in { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } \{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1\} after the ACR semantic gate. FVSP is the percentage of objects that complete every expected action without video-visible instability. It is a joint functional-and-visible-stability criterion based on rendered videos, not simulator logs.

Support marks indicate declared or evaluated capabilities, not successful outputs. Static assets remain evaluable for input consistency; missing or invalid interaction videos count as failures within the fixed action denominator. Failed and inconclusive attempts remain in the outcome accounting, with unsupported output types distinguished in the records. Development examples remain separate from the benchmark comparison.
blocks.zh: 支助标记表明已宣布或评价的能力,而不是成功的产出。 静态资产对于输入一致性仍然可以估价;缺少或无效的交互视频算作固定动作分母中的故障. 在结果会计中仍然有失败和无结果的尝试,记录中区分了无佐证的产出类型。 发展实例仍然与基准比较分开。

blocks.en: B.2  Inputs, Baselines, and Scoring
blocks.zh: B.2 投入、基线和计分

blocks.en: Section 4.1 specifies the common comparison protocol. Image-conditioned methods receive the same photograph; mesh-conditioned methods require an identified reconstruction and any auxiliary conditioning. Format and coordinate conversions are distinguished from geometry repair or inference of missing physical parameters, which would change the evaluated method. PhysXGen denotes the framework introduced in PhysX-3D ( Cao et al., 2025a ) . aDSL reports image-to-shape generation and articulated creation as a downstream application, motivating its inclusion in the single-image comparison.
blocks.zh: 第4.1节规定了共同比较协议。 图像条件方法接收到相同的照片;网状条件方法需要经确认的重建以及任何辅助设备。 格式和坐标转换与几何修复或对缺失物理参数的推论区分开来,这将改变评估的方法. PhysXGen表示在PhysX-3D中引入的框架(Cao等人,2025a). aDSL将图像到形状生成作为下游应用程序进行报告,并阐明创建方式,推动将其纳入单一图像比较。

blocks.en: Reference-based comparisons use compatible alignment, pose, sampling, distance normalization, and scoring settings. Shape normalization must preserve the separately assessed absolute-scale error. Table 2 follows the PhysXVerse/PhysX-Mobility split reported by PhysX-Omni; its kinematic score is not a dynamics success rate. Missing scores, marked by a dash or NR, are unreported entries rather than measured zeros.
blocks.zh: 基于参考的比较使用兼容的对齐,姿势,采样,距离正常化和评分设置. 形状正常化必须保留单独评估的绝对比例错误。 表2沿用了PhysXVerse/PhysX-Mobility拆分法,由PhysX-Omni报告;其运动分数不是动态成功率. 以破折号或NR标记的缺失分数是未报告的条目,而不是测量的零。

blocks.en: PhysX-Bench uses fixed evidence generation, evaluator configuration, and prompts across methods. Joint playback supplies articulation evidence, while material response and static appearance are separate observations; playback does not establish dynamic contact stability. The selected states in Figure 4 likewise demonstrate visible articulation and surface appearance. Table 7 summarizes the evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: PhysX-Bench使用固定的证据生成,评价器配置,以及跨方法的提示. 联合回放供应表达证据,而物质反应和静态外观则是单独的观测;回放不能建立动态接触稳定性. 图4中选定的州同样显示出明显的表达和表面外观。 表7概述了评价设置。

blocks.en: B.3  Ablation Configuration
blocks.zh: B.3 校准配置

blocks.en: The three variants in Section 4.5 share inputs, cached reconstructions, initial priors, model and decoding settings, construction tools, and final scoring. Full pipeline and w/o surface preservation share the two-repair limit and candidate-selection rule. One-shot returns the initial candidate and receives final scoring without feeding it back for repair. All attempted inputs, including failed and inconclusive runs, remain in the outcome accounting.
blocks.zh: 第4.5节的三个变体共享输入,缓存重建,初始前期,模型和解码设置,构造工具,以及最终评分. 完全管道和水/水面保护共用两层修补限度和候选规则。 一弹返回初选者,并获得最后的评分,而不反馈给修复者。 所有尝试投入,包括失败和无结果的投入,都留在成果会计中。

blocks.en: The source-preservation ablation removes construction-time geometry, UV, and material constraints while retaining the initial reconstruction and physical-to-visible bindings. It keeps output selection fixed, including the native-retention ranking criterion. The One-shot comparison measures refinement as a whole, including additional repair and candidate-selection opportunities; it does not isolate an individual feedback signal.
blocks.zh: 源保减除除施工时几何,紫外线,和物质限制,同时保留初始重建以及物理到可见的束缚. 它保持输出选择的固定,包括本土保留排名标准. " 一弹一射 " 比较衡量整个改进情况,包括额外修理和候选人选择机会;它不孤立个人反馈信号。
